description: Convert an amount between currencies using the latest or a historical rate. Returns the converted amount, rate, effective date and provenance. Legacy euro currencies use statutory factors from their adoption date. Cross-rates are triangulated through EUR without applying an accounting rounding policy.

amount.description: Amount in the base currency to convert. Must be greater than zero.

base_currency.description: ISO 4217 source currency code (e.g. USD). Call fx_list_currencies to get valid codes.

date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) for a historical rate. Omit for the latest available rate. Frankfurter v1 data starts 1999-01-04; fixed-only rates start at euro adoption. Future dates are not supported.

quote_currency.description: ISO 4217 target currency code (e.g. EUR). The amount will be expressed in this currency. Call fx_list_currencies to get valid codes.

name: fx_convert_currency

base_amount.description: The input amount in the base currency.

date_snapped.description: True when Frankfurter v1 served a prior publication date because the requested daily fix was unavailable. False for fixed-only and latest results.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `amount_out_of_range`: amount is too large to produce a finite value at the resolved rate. `invalid_date_format`: date is not a real calendar date written as YYYY-MM-DD. `unsupported_currency`: base_currency or quote_currency is not available in the current discovery or served historical data. `date_out_of_range`: date is in the future or precedes 1999-01-04 without an applicable fixed-only rate. `upstream_no_data`: Both currencies are supported but Frankfurter v1 has no observation for a requested currency on this date. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

fixed_rate_date.description: Date the statutory factors were applied, when different from the served market rate_date.

fixed_rates.description: Statutory factors used in the result, present only when a fixed leg was used.

adoption_date.description: First date the statutory factor applies (YYYY-MM-DD).

units_per_eur.description: Statutory units of this currency per EUR.

notice.description: Discloses restated units for historical RON or TRY rates.

quote_amount.description: Unrounded conversion at JavaScript floating-point precision, without a currency minor-unit rounding policy.

rate.description: Exchange rate used: units of quote currency per 1 unit of base currency.

rate_date.description: Served market publication date, or the requested date (current UTC date for latest) for a fixed-only result.

rate_type.description: Identifies Frankfurter v1 reference rates, statutory euro conversion, or a combination.

source.description: Source of the factors used in this result.

title: Fx Convert Currency
